quasium.progression.introduction.title: Welcome to Quasium!
quasium.progression.introduction.page1: Welcome to the world of Quasium! This mod adds a unique system of tobacco, hookahs, and kaif. Start your journey by exploring new mechanics and recipes.
quasium.progression.introduction.page2: First, find tobacco or makhorka seeds. They spawn in the world and can be harvested. Dry the leaves on a drying shelf, then ferment them in a barrel to get quality raw material.
quasium.progression.introduction.page3: After fermentation, use the mixing bowl to create your first tobacco. Try different flavors and mixes to unlock all the mod's possibilities!
quasium.progression.smelting_quasium.pag: Raw quasium can be found by mining quasium ore in the right kaif state. The higher your kaif — the more drops, as if the ore senses your mood.
Smelt raw quasium into an ingot to use for crafting quasium armor and other items.
quasium.progression.hookah.title: Hookah
quasium.progression.hookah.page1: The hookah is the heart of the mod. Place it on the ground and attach a pipe to start smoking. You need charcoal, tobacco, and a potion to create smoke.
quasium.progression.hookah.page2: Each tobacco flavor gives a unique effect: mint gives speed, citrus gives strength, berry gives jump boost. The higher the flavor percentage in the mix, the stronger the effect.
quasium.progression.hookah.page3: Experiment with mixes! Combine two flavors in a bowl to create unique combinations. At percentages above 70%, the effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.page4: Self-mixed tobacco is for experienced smokers. You can create pure tobacco with the desired strength, but remember: the stronger it is, the more dangerous the toxic smoke.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.mint: Speed — mint tobacco gives a speed effect. The higher the mint percentage, the stronger and longer. Above 70%, the effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.citrus: Strength — citrus tobacco gives a strength effect. The higher the citrus percentage, the stronger and longer. Above 70%, the effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.effect.berry: Jump Boost — berry tobacco gives a jump boost effect. The higher the berry percentage, the stronger and longer. Above 70%, the effect is amplified.
quasium.progression.hookah.self_mixed: Self-mixed (strength %s) — Deals %s toxic smoke damage. The stronger the tobacco, the more dangerous the smoke.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.title: Kaif Mastery
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.page1: You've reached a high kaif level! Kaif grows from smoking hookahs and unlocks new possibilities. The higher your kaif, the more secrets the world reveals.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.title: Quasium Ore
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page1: Deep underground lies quasium ore. It hides among deepslate and waits for someone who can unlock its potential. But not everyone can mine it...
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page2: The ore reveals itself only to those in the right state. You need a diamond pickaxe and a sufficient kaif level — otherwise the ore won't yield its treasures.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page3: The higher your kaif, the more generous the ore. At the minimum level it gives one piece, but at maximum disposition — up to four per block.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page4: There is a legend about silk touch... They say those who master this art can take the ore whole, without breaking it.
The ore has revealed its secrets for the first time! At the minimum suitable state it gives one piece of raw quasium.
A new sensation... the ore becomes more generous! Now it can give up to two pieces per block.
Deep disposition opens new horizons! The ore can give up to three pieces.
Perfect state! The ore reveals everything — up to four pieces per block. Maximum luck!
